{{Quote|Your aqua droids are no match for the Mon Calamari. What makes you think these secret weapons you brought from your homeworld will fare any better?''"<br />"''They are half machine, half monster. We call them Hydroid Medusa. They are ''invincible.''<u></u>|[[Nossor Ri/Legends|Nossor Ri]] and [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]] on Hydroid Medusas|<ref name="Water War">{{TCW|Water War}}</ref>}}
'''Hydroid Medusas''' were [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetically]] enhanced jellyfish developed as [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapons]] by the [[Karkarodon/Legends|Karkarodons]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Karkaris/Legends|Karkaris]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:HydroidMedusaSwarm-GA.png|thumb|left|250px|A swarm of Hydroid Medusas]]
Beautiful and dangerous at the same time, the Hydroid Medusas were large behemoths designed for underwater combat. They had on-board power plants and multiple electrified tentacles that could kill any biological being upon contact. However, they were at a risk of being short-circuited if near any electrical source.

==History==
During the last decade of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the aquatic [[Karkarodon/Legends|Karkarodons]] from the planet [[Karkaris/Legends|Karkaris]] designed a biological weapon known as the Hydroid Medusa.<ref name="SWE Hydroid Medusa" />

[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]] used a number of units in his [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|conquest]] of the planet [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], dropped onto the planet via [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|Separatist landing craft]]. Invulnerable to [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts and even [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] they proved a formidable opponent and forced the Republic and [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] resistance fighters to retreat with some casualties. Later Republic reinforcements in the form of the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] arrived, with their [[Booma/Legends|boomas]] temporarily short-circuiting some of the Hydroid Medusas, though a fair number of them remained dispersed in the oceans after the Gungan army was captured. The battle was eventually won by the Republic.
